# Generation fixture

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation

This fixed documentation corpus exercises parsing, transformation, runtime splitting, packing and filtering without downloading the live documentation.

## Block variants

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation#blocks

The following examples describe configuration and should remain associated with their code:

```js
const enabled = true
console.log(enabled)
```

These examples demonstrate the configuration in a small deterministic fixture.

::: details Configuration details

Additional configuration text remains available after the wrapper is transformed.

:::

| Setting | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| enabled | Enables the feature &amp; its configuration |
| module | `<a valid Maven groupId>` |

<table>
<tr><th>Setting</th><th>Reference</th></tr>
<tr><td>pool</td><td><a href="/docs/java/multitenancy#db-connection-pooling">Connection pooling</a></td></tr>
<tr><td>module</td><td>&lt;a valid Maven groupId&gt;</td></tr>
</table>

1. First configure the feature with a supported setting.
2. Then verify that the configuration takes effect.

- Enable the documented option before starting the process.
- Confirm the resulting configuration using the example output.

[Additional documentation](./configuration){.learn-more}

> [!danger] Never undeploy hdbtable files
> ::: code-group
> ```json
> { "undeploy": [] }
> ```
> :::

## Runtime variants

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation#runtimes

Shared instructions apply to both runtimes before their specific configuration is selected.

<div class="impl java">

Java configuration uses the documented runtime service and provides instructions with enough content to survive filtering.

```java
configureRuntime();
```

</div>

<div class="impl node">

Node.js configuration uses the documented runtime service and provides instructions with enough content to survive filtering.

```js
configureRuntime()
```

</div>

<div class="cols-2">

The first column describes a supported configuration that is useful to readers.

The second column describes an alternative configuration that is equally useful.

</div>

### Nested configuration

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation#nested

Nested configuration retains its heading path and source annotation when deeper sections are folded.

#### Further configuration

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation#further

Further configuration provides sufficient content for packing into a retained documentation section.

##### Advanced configuration

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation#advanced

Advanced configuration illustrates the heading depth policy without relying on the complete live corpus.

###### Deep configuration

> Source: /docs/fixtures/generation#deep

Deep configuration is folded when the configured heading depth excludes this section boundary.
